name: Trend Micro Deep Security
description: The Sumo Logic App for Trend Micro Deep Security works with system and security events to monitor event history such as anti-malware, IPS, web reputation, firewall, integrity and log inspection events.

panels.name: Anti-Malware Event History
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/TrendMicro
| parse "CEF:0|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as Device_Vendor,Device_Product,Device_Version,Signature_ID, Name, Severity, Extension
| where signature_id >= 4000000 AND signature_id <= 4999999
| parse regex field=extension "act=(?<Action>.+?)\s\w+?=" nodrop
| timeslice 30m 
| count _timeslice, Action | transpose row _timeslice column Action

panels.name: Top 5 Detected Malware
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/TrendMicro
| parse "CEF:0|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as Device_Vendor,Device_Product,Device_Version,Signature_ID, Name, Severity, Extension
| where signature_id >= 4000000 AND signature_id <= 4999999
| count Name 
| top 5 Name by _count

panels.name: Firewall Events History
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/TrendMicro dst
| parse "CEF:0|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as Device_Vendor,Device_Product,Device_Version,Signature_ID, Name, Severity, Extension 
| where (signature_id >= 100 AND signature_id <= 199) OR signature_id = 20 OR signature_id = 21 | "Firewall" as deepsecuritysource 
| timeslice 30m | count _timeslice, Name | transpose row _timeslice column Name

panels.name: Reconnaissance Scan History
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/TrendMicro 
| parse "CEF:0|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as Device_Vendor,Device_Product,Device_Version,Signature_ID, Name, Severity, Extension
| where signature_id >= 850 AND signature_id <= 854
| if (name matches "Reconnaissance Detected: TCP SYNFIN Scan", "TCP SYNFIN Scan", name) as name | if (name matches "Reconnaissance Detected: Computer OS Fingerprint Probe", "Computer OS Fingerprint Probe", name) as name | if (name matches "Reconnaissance Detected: TCP Xmas Scan", "TCP Xmas Scan", name) as name | if (name matches "Reconnaissance Detected: TCP Null Scan", "TCP Null Scan", name) as name | if (name matches "Reconnaissance Detected: Network or Port Scan", "Network or Port Scan", name) as name 
| timeslice 30m | count _timeslice, name | transpose row _timeslice column name

panels.name: Integrity Monitoring Event History
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/TrendMicro
| parse "CEF:0|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as Device_Vendor,Device_Product,Device_Version,Signature_ID, Name, Severity, Extension
| where signature_id = 30 OR signature_id >= 2000000 AND signature_id <= 2999999
| "Integrity Monitoring" as deepsecuritysource | "" as eventseverity | if(Severity=3,"Low",eventseverity) as eventseverity | if(Severity=6,"Medium",eventseverity) as eventseverity | if(Severity=8,"High",eventseverity) as eventseverity | if(Severity=9,"Unknown/Error",eventseverity) as eventseverity | if(Severity=10,"Critical",eventseverity) as eventseverity
| timeslice 30m
| count _timeslice, eventseverity | transpose row _timeslice column eventseverity

children.name: Trend Micro - Deep Security - Intrusion Prevention System

panels.name: IPS Event History
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/TrendMicro  dst
| parse "CEF:0|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as Device_Vendor,Device_Product,Device_Version,Signature_ID, Name, Severity, Extension
|where (signature_id >= 200 AND signature_id <= 299) OR (signature_id >= 300 AND signature_id <= 399) OR (signature_id >= 500 AND signature_id <= 899) OR signature_id = 10 OR (signature_id >= 1000000 AND signature_id <= 1999999)
| "Intrusion Prevention" as deepsecuritysource
| parse regex field=extension "act=(?<Action>.+?)\s\w+?=" nodrop
| if(action matches "IDS:*","Detect","Prevent") as action
| timeslice 30m
| count _timeslice, action | transpose row _timeslice column action

panels.name: Top 5 Source IPs For Detected IPS Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/TrendMicro dst
| parse "CEF:0|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as Device_Vendor,Device_Product,Device_Version,Signature_ID, Name, Severity, Extension |where (signature_id >= 200 AND signature_id <= 299) OR (signature_id >= 300 AND signature_id <= 399) OR (signature_id >= 500 AND signature_id <= 899) OR signature_id = 10 OR (signature_id >= 1000000 AND signature_id <= 1999999) | "Intrusion Prevention" as deepsecuritysource | parse regex field=extension "act=(?<Action>.+?)\s\w+?=" nodrop
| parse regex field=extension "src=(?<src_ip>.+?)\s\w+?=" nodrop 
| if(action matches "IDS:*","Detect","Prevent") as action 
| where action = "Detect" 
| count src_ip | top 5 src_ip by _count

children.name: Trend Micro - Deep Security - Log Inspection

panels.name: Log Inspection Events History
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/TrendMicro 
| parse "CEF:0|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as Device_Vendor,Device_Product,Device_Version,Signature_ID, Name, Severity, Extension
| where signature_id = 40 OR signature_id >= 3000000 AND signature_id <= 3999999 
| "Log Inspection" as deepsecuritysource
| if(severity=3,"Low","") as eventseverity | if(severity=6,"Medium",eventseverity) as eventseverity | if(severity=8,"High",eventseverity) as eventseverity | if(severity=9,"Unknown/Error",eventseverity) as eventseverity | if(severity=10,"Critical",eventseverity) as eventseverity
| timeslice 30m
| count _timeslice, eventseverity | transpose row _timeslice column eventseverity
